references.text: The prophecy of the humble king coming riding on a donkey, which John 12:14 directly quotes as fulfillment.
The specific greeting to him who comes in the name of the Lord, which the people shouted during Jesus' entry.
Matthew quoted the same prophecy from Zechariah to emphasize that Jesus fulfills the role of the humble king.
Luke describes the event where Jesus found and sat on a donkey, in line with the prophecy.
Mark tells of Jesus finding a donkey and sitting on it as a sign of prophetic fulfillment.
